description:
Schloss Englar stands among vineyards and orchards at San Michele/St. Michael in Appiano/Eppan, on the South Tyrol Wine Road. It is first recorded in documents in 1256, according to the local tourist board, and its Chapel of St Sebastian dates from 1475 and has 16th-century frescoes; two coats of arms above the main entrance record a marriage link with the Thun family. The local tourist board and the hotel listings are the main sources for this account.

The castle passed to the Counts Khuen in the 17th century (sources give 1621 or 1640), and the Khuen-Belasi family still owns it. The family also runs the castle winery.

A hotel was set up in the west wing in 1980, and the rooms were renovated in 2015. Today the guest rooms are a castle bed and breakfast, and the estate has a common room with an open fireplace, a garden with an outdoor pool and a terrace. Breakfast was included on the rate seen, and Booking required a minimum stay of two nights on the dates checked.
history: Schloss Englar in Appiano/Eppan is first recorded in 1256. In the 17th century it passed to the Counts Khuen, later Khuen-Belasi, who still own it; sources give 1621 or 1640 for the change of ownership. Its Chapel of St Sebastian dates from 1475. In 1980 the family set up guest rooms in the west wing, renovated in 2015, and they also run a winery on the estate.

hotel.room_location_note: Guest rooms are in the west wing of the castle; ask the hotel which room and floor you are in
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** The castle stands at Pigano 42 in San Michele/St. Michael, Appiano/Eppan, on the South Tyrol Wine Road about 10 km south-west of Bolzano. Booking lists free private parking with electric charging and accessible parking.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €344/night for a 30 m² Large Double Room with a queen bed, a view, a private bathroom and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast and free cancellation included on the rate seen (no prepayment); a Junior Suite was around €390 a night and a Deluxe Double Room with a balcony around €408. Booking required a minimum stay of two nights on the dates checked, and showed a small tax charge (about €5 for the two nights) separately.

**On-site:** A common room with an open fireplace, a garden with an outdoor pool and a terrace, the castle winery, free parking and free Wi-Fi.

**Good to know:** Rates were seen for one May 2027 stay, so check your own dates on Booking; Booking showed no availability for late January. Guest rooms are in the castle's west wing, and there is no restaurant for dinner.

**Combine with:** [Schloss Korb](/castles/italy/schloss-korb), another castle hotel in Appiano, about 3.5 km to the north, and [Sigmundskron Castle](/castles/italy/sigmundskron-castle), a castle you can visit, about 5 km to the north-east.
